messages:
Mia: Heads-up — we need to onboard comet-34b for chat/toolcall + structured-output tomorrow. Primary constraints: quantized run (fp4 target), p50 latency target ~120ms on A100-80GB, and baseline accuracy close to fp16. @Ravi @Zach can you own infra + evals?
Ravi: Got it. Do we have the model weights and HF repo link yet? Also want to confirm: are we locking on fp4 (q4_0) or starting with int8 baseline first?
Mia: HF link inbound (I'll attach to the intake ticket). Start with q4_0 fp4-first, keep int8 as fallback. Record both.
Zach: I'll enqueue this into the benchmarking queue. Need: small prompt set for smoke, structured-output schema, and the eval suites (convqa, openqa, api-struct). Can someone paste a sample prompt and the expected JSON schema?
Eva: Sample chat template to enforce structured outputs (use system -> assistant -> user pattern). Paste example: ```json
{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a tool-aware assistant. ALWAYS return valid JSON matching the schema in the user message. Do NOT add explanatory text."},{"role":"user","content":"SCHEMA: {\"action\": \"string\", \"args\": {\"tool_id\": \"string\", \"params\": \"object\"}, \"confidence\": \"number\"}\\nPROMPT: Search for recent Redwood Inference blog posts about quantization."} ] }
```
Mia: Exact schema we want for production: top-level keys action (string | null), args (object with tool_id:string and params:object), confidence (float 0-1). If no action required return action:null and an empty args object. Always include a source array for citations when available.
Ravi: For quant experiments I'll spin up an infra matrix: q4_0, q4_k_float, and int8. We'll capture token throughput, p50/p95 latency, and memory. Important: log KV cache usage and end-to-end latency (SDK + network).
Zach: For evals: we'll compute EM/F1 for QA, schema compliance % for structured outputs, and hallucination rate (false tool calls) on a labeled subset. Gate rule: fail on regressions >3% vs fp16 on critical sets.
Mia: Prioritization checklist I propose: 1) container + inference image build; 2) small smoke test (5 prompts) with schema enforcement; 3) quant baseline runs (q4_0 + q4_k); 4) full eval sweep (accuracy + latency); 5) structured-output canary behind feature flag. Assign: Ravi infra, Zach evals, Eva prompts.
Ravi: Adding config to model-intake: model_name=comet-34b, entrypoint=redwood/inference:comet-34b, quant_targets=[q4_0,q4_k], batcher=auto, autoscale=min=1,max=4. I'll link the PR here once ready.
Eva: Quick API integration notes: include function/tool definitions in the SDK call *and* mirror the JSON schema in the system prompt. Example (JS): ```javascript
await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'comet-34b',
  messages,
  functions: [{ name: 'search', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { q: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['q'] } }],
  temperature: 0.0
})
```
Also recommend validating the assistant output server-side with a lightweight JSON schema validator and fallback to a search-only path if parsing fails.
Zach: I'll add automated gating to CI: - accuracy drop >3% -> block; - hallucination rate >2% -> alert; - latency p50 >150ms -> throttle canary.
ci-bot: nightly-bench: comet-34b quant jobs queued on dev-cluster (job ids: 4829, 4830).
Mia: Perfect. I'll create intake ticket #4621 and paste this thread + sample prompts. Please drop early logs/PR links here. :thumbsup:
